_comment: Perk adapter: Ordinator 9.35.0. Ordinator's spell perks read vanilla keywords (vanilla.json
covers them). The ORD_ keywords its perks ask about mark Ordinator's own effects, checked in
Ordinator's plugin: ORD_Des_AnyFireDamageHazard_Keyword sits on its one marker effect, which
World in Flames also looks for directly; ORD_Con_BoneCollector_Keyword_Summon on its six
created-skeleton effects (Reap and Sow). None describes a spell, so nothing is added here.
The file stays so the measurement is on record for the next Ordinator version.
FormLists: the ones its perks test are filled by its scripts in play (Arcane Thesis: the spell
the player masters) or hold no spells; ORD_Alt_NaturalMagic_FormList_Exclusion (bound weapons)
is read by a script, not a perk condition. None is filled from here.
